findings: An independent one-scale oracle matched raw clearances, family priors, the behavior score, all family scores, bottleneck weights, the hard bottleneck, compensation bounds, and direction flags in 60000 random K=2..16 cases with zero discrepancies.

A 60000-case common-unit rescaling probe found score covariance error at most 2.842170943040401e-14, bottleneck-weight invariance error at most 7.549516567451064e-15, and zero limiting-coordinate mismatches.
The pooled q90 soft-min scale is 0.31063783855250376 log2 and the campaign-scale four-state compensation bounds are 0.7719060307 log2 for a prior of 1/12 and 0.6825410935 log2 for a prior of 1/9.
The objective suite has 84 passing tests; the reviewed study slice has 29 passing shadow and completion-gate tests.
The active executable campaign is secg_msrb_greedy. The secg_rmf_greedy slug appears only inside the frozen comparator provenance outside the campaign registry.
Growth, feasibility, absolute OFF, cross-view score comparability, predictor quality, prospective enrichment, and hill climbing remain non-claims.
